name: Asterism
source:
Kotachi isn't exactly a social outcast- he has 1 whole friend- but he's not super outgoing either. Added to his lack of being social, he's been able to see specters since he was 10- a type of creature that lurks in darkness and harness energy from creatures, but are invisible to almost the entire world. In order to combat these creatures, weapons formed from constellations were dropped all around the world centuries ago. Armed with a pair of revolvers after the constellation Perseus, Kotachi fights specters at night and makes a few unexpected friends along with way- including a few human constellations, the Zodiac.

[From [url=http://mikomikisomi.weebly.com/asterism] Mikomi Game's Website[/url]]
translation:
小太并不是一个被社会抛弃的人——他只有一个朋友——但他也不是超级外向。除了缺乏社交能力之外，他从10岁起就能够看到幽灵——一种潜伏在黑暗中并利用生物能量的生物，但几乎整个世界都看不见。为了对抗这些生物，几个世纪前，由星座组成的武器被投放到世界各地。带着一对英仙座左轮手枪，小太在夜间与幽灵作战，并一路上结识了一些意想不到的朋友——其中包括一些人类星座——黄道十二宫。

[来自[url=http://mikomikisomi.weebly.com/asterism] Mikomi Game网站[/url]]
